context: Sakura and Asuka celebrate at a small gathering after the contest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、今日、来てくれて、嬉しい。
lines.en: Teacher — I'm really glad you came today.
lines.style: Soft opening, genuine gratitude threading through. Slow pace, eyes warm and present. Small pause before 'today' like she's letting the moment settle. Voice sits low in the chest — not performed, deeply sincere.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: こちらこそ、お祝い、出来て。
lines.en: I'm the one who's happy to be here celebrating with you.
lines.style: Warm, steady voice. Slight lean forward on 'celebrating.' Gentle conviction — she means every word. Unhurried delivery. The tone of someone who shows up for people who matter.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一年間、本当、頑張りました。
lines.en: I really worked hard this whole year.
lines.style: Reflective, not boastful. Slight breathiness on 'really' — acknowledging the effort cost her something. Trailing off gently, letting the year settle behind her. Quiet pride underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: I've watched how much you've grown.
lines.style: Measured, observant tone. Soft weight on 'watched' — she's been paying attention the whole time. No rush. Each word precise. The voice of someone who notices what others miss.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夢、ずっと、追っていきます。
lines.en: I'm going to keep chasing my dream.
lines.style: Conviction gathers under the surface. Slight acceleration on 'keep' — determination, not desperation. Voice opens a little. Ends with quiet strength, like she's telling herself as much as her teacher.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: That's a beautiful way to live.
lines.style: Soft affirmation. Gentle pause after the opening word. Her voice settles on 'beautiful' like she's choosing it carefully. Steady, not effusive. The wisdom of someone who recognizes real things.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Vulnerability and strength at once. Quiet but clear. No hiding — she's letting her teacher see her joy. Slight tremor of genuine emotion underneath. Brief, because the truth doesn't need decoration.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: I'll keep supporting you from here on.
lines.style: Steady promise. Slight emphasis on 'keep' — this isn't a goodbye. Warm, unhurried pace. Voice carries the weight of actual follow-through. Ends with gentle openness, like a door staying open.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一緒に、ここまで、来てくれて。
lines.en: You came this far with me.
lines.style: Soft gratitude, almost vulnerable. Slight catch on 'came' — she's feeling the closeness of this moment. Slow, deliberate pacing. Voice sits tender. Not asking for reassurance, but offering recognition of what they built together.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: There's still so much road ahead of you.
lines.style: Grounded, philosophical. Slight lift on 'still' — not closure but opening. Measured pace. Her voice carries both encouragement and quiet knowing. Not rushing her into the future, just steadying her for it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Quiet determination. Slight emphasis on 'keep' — a commitment, not just hope. Voice opens at 'always,' letting the promise breathe. No wavering. The conviction of someone who means what she says.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: Your dream will definitely come true.
lines.style: Gentle certainty. Weight and warmth on 'definitely' — not wishful thinking, but belief earned from watching. Slow, unhurried delivery. Voice carries the teacher's steady knowing. Ends with quiet conviction, like a door closing gently on something certain.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Full, quiet gratitude. Slight pause after opening word. Voice holds all the year between them — not just words, but the weight of being seen and believed in. Small, sincere, real. Slight tremor of genuine feeling.
